items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Annie's Dance' and the interviewee confirms the arrangement, but no personal interaction or relationship with a person named Annie is described.

ctx.x: I don’t know. I should have talked to them. I don’t know if they knew or if I was a surprise or anything. I don’t know. But the heads of state or something knew we were coming. I don’t know about the masses. I don’t know.

But it’s been said over there, at the State Department – on a State Department tour, that your arrangement on My Reverie – no, Anitra’s Dance – Annie’s Dance would break the ice, because there was – they recognized the theme and they liked your arrangement – treatment of it. Is that true?
